description:
Simulated crypto top-up for a QuantifyMe DEV server only: no money moves,
    so it never makes an account paid and grants at most up to the free credit
    cap ($100 per call). quantifyme.ai refuses it (#1098) and answers with how to
    pay for real: send USDC on Base to your deposit address
    (GET /api/v1/wallet/deposit_address). Returns your new credit balance.
name: top_up
title: Top Up Credits with Crypto
